craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra-adbhuta of tended glory through impurity — the Lord in wandering (v14 absent in data too: edition numbering gap, not a defect; L4 follows the L3 set). Five mirrored (god-does/self-does); delusion-only-difference close. Rejected: (a) delusion→error → killed: delusion is the term. Read aloud: ALL-per-VAD-ing … POW-er-de-LUD-ed THE-on-ly DIFF-er-ence.

lines: All-pervading — as great god does five, so this self does too —
l4.sanskrit_cite: vyāpī yadvan mahādevaḥ kroti pañcakṛtyatām | tadvad evāyam ātmāpi kurute śaktimohitaḥ

reads_against.argmap: Who does the five acts? → As god does five, so self does, power-deluded.
c1_essence: Tended means; Lord tends; release-glory proceeds.
God's five, self's five; delusion the difference.
Expansion sung capable; contraction called wanderer.
Withdrawn grace in oneness; manifesting named veiling.
